job.prompt:
Create a single-level 2D platformer called The Last Knight.

The entire game takes place in a ruined medieval castle arena.

There is exactly ONE enemy: a powerful knight boss. No smaller enemies.

The boss should have three recognizable attacks: a charging attack, a ranged attack, and a powerful attack with a clear warning before it happens.

When the boss falls below half health, increase the attack intensity.

Give the boss a large visible health bar. Give my character a usable combat ability, responsive movement, and clear attack and damage animations.

I win only by defeating the boss.

No collectibles, no quests, no exit gate to reach, and no additional levels.

Make the fight dramatic, challenging, and visually cohesive.
